screens.title: Today · 3 godowns
screens.caption: Stock you can trust, in one view: value, idle stock with rupees attached, what is below reorder, and what moved since yesterday.

screens.title: Stock
screens.caption: Every SKU with age, value and velocity — and next to the dead stock, what the system suggests doing with it.

screens.title: Bins · Godown A
screens.caption: A live map of every bin: what is in it, how full, how old. Red is idle stock; amber is below reorder. Tap a bin to see its history.

screens.title: Movements
screens.caption: Receipts, issues, transfers and returns — every one scanned on a phone at the bin, timestamped, tied to a document. Nothing is typed twice.

screens.title: Reorder
screens.caption: Reorder points that learn from velocity and lead time, and POs drafted for you — sent to the vendor on WhatsApp the moment you approve.

screens.title: Counts · phone
screens.caption: Counting on a phone, bin by bin, with the expected quantity hidden until the count is entered — variances explained on the spot, no clipboard.

screens.title: Reports
screens.caption: Ageing, turns, accuracy and the rupees recovered from dead stock — compiled every night, sent to the owner every Monday.
